judge_evidence_notes: CVE-2017-2599 involves project creation/rename paths where visibility-based lookup can miss an existing unauthorized item, allowing overwrite of that exact item name.
The relevant safe fix is an existence/authorization-aware check before creation or rename, with the checked item identity and scope preserved through the mutation path.

The supplied trace establishes pre-patch/fix-oriented source evidence and retrieval ground truth; it is not independent exploit proof, but it is sufficient mechanism evidence for this semantic judgment.
main_issue: The sole case directly matches missing authorization bound to the exact affected object: a creator can overwrite an existing same-name item that is hidden from them. The cluster summary is inconsistent with this authorization mechanism, but it does not undermine this one-case guideline group.
mechanism_name: missing object-owner or tenant-scope authorization
reviewer_action: Keep as a semantic control group and preserve it in regression review.

example_cases.first_trace_evidence: ZIP extraction iterates ZipArchiveEntry objects in physical order, opens each entry stream, and passes entry name, mode, symlink destination from resolveSymlink(), and content stream into AbstractUnArchiver.extractFile().

judge_evidence_notes: ZIP and TAR entry handling passes attacker-controlled entry names, symlink destinations, and content streams into the shared extraction routine.
The shared routine checks lexical/canonical containment but does not prevent a normal-file write from following a target path that is already a symbolic link.
A malicious archive can place a symlink entry before a subsequent regular-file entry, causing the later write to resolve outside the extraction root.
main_issue: The single case directly supports the stated archive-created or pre-existing symlink-following write mechanism; physical extraction order is an important exploit precondition and is already captured by the guideline.
mechanism_name: archive extraction escape through symlink-following writes
reviewer_action: Keep as a semantic control group and preserve it in regression review.
